solves.reasoning: (A) 'live in ___ areas without much threat'=peaceful, (B) 'broadcast the threat over loudspeaker'=broadcast, (C) 'times are truly ___'=tough → peaceful—broadcast—tough
(A) 'incredibly ___ — comprehensible only to close kin'=specific, (B) 'easily understood by all'=easily, (C) 'communications are ___ to both'=beneficial → specific—easily—beneficial
(A) 'rare occasion they are ___'=attacked, (B) 'more ___ territory'=hostile, (C) 'left standing in a field ___'=alone → attacked—hostile—alone
④ harmful은 'communications are beneficial to both sender and receiver' 긍정 맥락과 모순되어 부적절
① hardly는 'phrases easily understood by all'(모두가 이해)와 모순되어 부적절
② ignored는 신호가 모든 미역취에게 '이해되게' 하려는 목적과 모순되어 부적절
'without much threat from ___' 위협의 근원이므로 predators(포식자)
'signal to their ___ using chemical phrases' 신호 대상이므로 neighbors(이웃)
'broadcast the threat over ___' coded whisper와 대조되는 확성기=loudspeaker
issue(발하다/내보내다)의 동의어는 release(내보내다)
comprehensible(이해할 수 있는)의 동의어는 understandable
confirmed(확인했다)의 동의어는 verified(입증했다)
hostile(적대적인)의 반의어는 friendly(우호적인); aggressive는 유사어 함정
close(가까운)의 반의어는 distant(먼); nearby/intimate는 유사어 함정
(A) standing in a field=들판·벌판, (B) field of molecular biology=분야·영역
the plant ___ (receive) them → 명사 the plant를 수식하는 능동 현재분사 receiving
'an animal that lives by hunting and eating other animals'=predator(포식자)
phrases easily ___ (understand) by all → 수동 과거분사 understood
'Instead of using ___ ... broadcast over loudspeaker' 대조 구조=coded whisper networks
'no one to mate with, no one to help ___' 번식 병렬=bring in pollinators
